'''2017 Worlds Day 3 Tom Haid LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Haid]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Haid]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
